hook_line: 63 IN CONGRESS PUSH FASTER GREEN CARDS

hook_stat.sub: Members of Congress urging USCIS to expedite green cards

stats.label: People in nine states and DC facing Medicaid loss from October 1

news_summary: Sixty-three members of Congress, including three Indian-American lawmakers, urged USCIS to expedite green cards for immigrants losing health coverage.
payoff: USCIS has not yet agreed to the requests.
